name: Azeroth Companion
title: WORLD ATLAS OVERDRIVE — Cartographic Map & Destination Intelligence
approval_note: Project owner requested v18 Atlas realism, icon pins, performance and useful map intelligence. Automated browser/source checks are advisory. Physical iPhone and live WoW account acceptance pending.
features: World Atlas Overdrive: a new detailed original fantasy cartographic continent map, compact and locally bundled, preserving eight familiar research regions and an Outland portal inset.
Interactive zone icon charts: all 25 curated World of Warcraft destinations display crown, compass or terrain icons with readable selected-place information.
Local mission overlays and filters: see your own planned, in-progress and manually completed missions, bookmark stars and v17 session markers directly on the Atlas.
Connected zone intelligence: inspect existing personal mission counts and local character, Talent Forge draft and Item Atlas references, with one-tap Expedition and Operations handoffs.
A private map-art preview accepts your own PNG/JPEG/WebP under 8 MB; no upload or automatic pin alignment. Restore the original map instantly.
Cinematic and iPhone performance modes, reduced-motion support, mobile tap controls, accessible icons and source-linked external Warcraft Wiki map references.

All v16/v16.5 mission data, v17 Adventure Operations, Blizzard OAuth, Cloudflare routing, saved builds, music and studios preserved; owner-approved release with physical-device/gameplay acceptance pending.
